what: A single line of text is typed one character at a time at 30ms intervals (space is reserved from the start so the line does not shift)

options.frames: Cut like a GIF — lights the letters evenly over this many frames (frame seconds per frame). If given, used instead of step
options.frame: Length of one frame in the frames type (sec), default .1
options.when: When ‹shown›, instead of scrolling, it types from the start every time the element becomes visible (itself and ancestors at opacity .1 or more — checked every 100ms) and clears when hidden again. When finished the element emits fx:typed — on the card text panel that rises on hover
options.fx:typed: when: shown, an event the element emits the moment the last character is typed. The consumer turns on “Show more” here
options.dur: Spreads the whole text evenly over this length (sec) — one character per step = dur ÷ tempo count. If given, used instead of step
options.caret: Cursor character (e.g. |). If given, untyped characters also leave their space empty (text grows) and the cursor follows the end, disappearing once typing is done
options.end: ScrollTrigger end — spot that also fires once when passed and then returned upward (onEnterBack)
options.mask: Mask character (e.g. *) — if given, characters not yet typed are not hidden but covered with this character, then swapped one by one to the real character (spaces stay). Password field · title tail like ‹works with AI›
